annotation.title_clean: MESA INTERMINISTERIAL SOBRE INTELIGENCIA ARTIFICIAL - Decisión Administrativa 750/2023
annotation.title_en: Inter-Ministerial Roundtable on Artificial Intelligence - Administrative Decision 750/2023
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Jefatura de Gabinete de Ministros, Argentina (Boletín Oficial de la República Argentina)
annotation.venue: Boletín Oficial de la República Argentina
annotation.summary_en: Argentine Administrative Decision 750/2023 creates an Inter-Ministerial Roundtable on Artificial Intelligence under the Cabinet Chief's office, coordinated with the Secretariat of Strategic Affairs, to design a comprehensive national AI strategy within an ethical, sustainable and digital-transformation framework. It contains no robotics-specific provisions.
key_provisions_or_claims: Creates the Mesa Interministerial sobre IA within the Jefatura de Gabinete de Ministros.
Mandate: design a comprehensive AI strategy under an ethical, sustainable development framework.
Members: Cabinet Office and ministries of science, defence, economy, foreign affairs, health, security, labour, plus Strategic Affairs Secretariat.
Coordinators may invite other public and private entities.
Recognises need for diagnostics and regulatory frameworks, drawing on other countries' experience.
